full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white street photograph looks down a broad staircase toward a single small figure on an open tiled concourse. The stairs begin at the lower edge and rise away from the camera toward the middle of the selected panel, their horizontal treads becoming narrower with distance. High dark sidewalls angle inward from both lower corners, framing a wide opening at the top. Beyond them, rectangular paving stones fill the upper half in a staggered grid, with subtle differences between gray and almost white tiles. A lone figure stands near the center of that open area, tiny against the large expanse of ground. The person wears a dark knee-length coat or dress and has a rounded dark head shape; arms stay close to the body, and facial features cannot be resolved from this height. A narrow dark shadow falls below the figure toward the stairs. Light pools on the paving around the person, then fades toward the upper and side edges of the concourse. The steps closest to the viewer are almost black, their edges readable only as thin horizontal gray divisions. The camera viewpoint is elevated and centered on the stair axis, making the tiled field seem broad and exposed while the foreground feels enclosed. There are no signs, other pedestrians, or legible writing in the chosen scene. The overall composition depends on one tiny dark vertical against a bright circular field, with strong stair geometry and deep surrounding shade creating isolation and quiet tension.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白街头照片从高处沿宽楼梯向下望去，远处开阔的铺砖广场上只有一名渺小人物。楼梯从所选单图下缘开始，背离镜头向中央升去，水平踏步随距离增加而变窄。高高的深色侧墙从两个下角向内斜伸，在上端围出宽阔开口。墙外，长方铺砖以错列网格填满上半部，灰色与近白色石块之间有细微差别。一个人站在这片开阔区域中央附近，在广大的地面前显得极小。此人穿深色及膝外套或裙装，头部呈圆形深色，双臂靠近身体；从这一高度无法辨认五官。一道狭窄深影从人物脚下朝楼梯方向落下。光集中照亮人物周围的砖面，朝广场上缘与两侧逐渐变暗。最近处的台阶近乎漆黑，边缘仅以细水平灰线可辨。镜头视点较高、对准楼梯中轴，使铺砖区域显得宽阔无遮，前景却被围住。所选画面中没有标志、其他行人或可读文字。整体构图依靠明亮圆形区域中的一个极小深色竖形，以强烈楼梯几何与周围深影形成孤立和安静张力。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white street photography uses high-angle symmetry, strict paving geometry, and a single tiny dark accent. A broad zone of mid-gray rectangular texture opens beyond near-black foreground planes; light concentrates in a soft central pool rather than spreading evenly. Repeating horizontal steps and converging sidewalls pull the eye toward the distant focal mark. Tonal gradation is smooth across the open floor but abrupt at the dark stairwell, allowing both architectural order and atmospheric depth. Grain is modest and surface detail remains believable. Extensive negative space makes the small accent feel isolated without needing narrative detail. The overall effect is spare, graphic, and quietly tense.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白街头摄影利用高角度对称、严格铺砖几何和单个极小深色重音。中灰长方纹理构成宽阔开放区域，从近黑色前景平面外展开；光集中成柔和的中央亮池，而非平均铺满。重复的水平台阶和汇聚侧墙把视线牵向远处焦点。开放地面的明度渐变平滑，抵达深暗楼梯口时则突然转折，兼有建筑秩序与空气纵深。颗粒克制，表面细节保持可信。大片负空间无需叙事情节也让小重音显得孤立。整体效果简练、图形感强且安静紧张。
theme_en: A lone small figure crossing a tiled concourse beyond a dark staircase
theme_zh: 一名渺小的独行者穿过暗色楼梯外的铺砖广场
name: Thomas Leuthard
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
